answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 49567 Country: AU Title: Overpayment of Zakat Question: I have overpaid my Zakat for this year due to some over-estimation of my income. Can you please confirm the status of this overpaid amount? Should I consider it as sadqa? Or can I set-off this amount of over-payment with my Zakat due next year, so as to reduce the amount payable next year by the amount of Zakat over-paid this year? Answer ID: 49567 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 28/76/D=01/1435) If the extra amount was paid with the intention of zakah, you may count it in the next year’s zakah. (Fatawa Darul Uloom 6:93) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
